def as_json_table_type(x: DtypeObj) -> str:
    """
    Convert a NumPy / pandas type to its corresponding json_table.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x : np.dtype or ExtensionDtype

    Returns
    -------
    str
        the Table Schema data types

    Notes
    -----
    This table shows the relationship between NumPy / pandas dtypes,
    and Table Schema dtypes.

    ==============  =================
    Pandas type     Table Schema type
    ==============  =================
    int64           integer
    float64         number
    bool            boolean
    datetime64[ns]  datetime
    timedelta64[ns] duration
    object          str
    categorical     any
    =============== =================
    """
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    import pandas.api.types as ptypes
    from pandas.api.extensions import ExtensionDtype
    from pandas.core.dtypes.common import DatetimeTZDtype, PeriodDtype

    if ptypes.is_integer_dtype(x):
        return "integer"
    elif ptypes.is_bool_dtype(x):
        return "boolean"
    elif ptypes.is_numeric_dtype(x):
        return "number"
    elif pd.core.dtypes.dtypes.is_dtype_equal(x, np.dtype("datetime64[ns]")) or isinstance(x, (DatetimeTZDtype, PeriodDtype)):
        return "datetime"
    elif pd.core.dtypes.dtypes.is_dtype_equal(x, np.dtype("timedelta64[ns]")):
        return "duration"
    elif isinstance(x, ExtensionDtype):
        return "any"
    elif ptypes.is_string_dtype(x):
        return "str"
    else:
        return "any"

def as_json_table_type(x: DtypeObj) -> str:
    """
    Convert a NumPy / pandas type to its corresponding json_table.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x : np.dtype or ExtensionDtype

    -------

        the Table Schema data types

    Notes
    -----
    This table shows the relationship between NumPy / pandas dtypes,
    and Table Schema dtypes.

    ==============  =================
    Pandas type     Table Schema type
    ==============  =================
    int64           integer
    float64         number
    bool            boolean
    datetime64[ns]  datetime
    timedelta64[ns] duration
    object          str
    categorical     any
    =============== =================
    """
    import pandas as pd
    from pandas.api.types import is_integer_dtype, is_bool_dtype, is_numeric_dtype, is_datetime64_ns_dtype, is_timedelta64_ns_dtype, is_string_dtype
    from pandas.api.extensions import ExtensionDtype
    from pandas.core.dtypes.common import DatetimeTZDtype, PeriodDtype

    if is_integer_dtype(x):
        return "integer"
    elif is_bool_dtype(x):
        return "boolean"
    elif is_numeric_dtype(x):
        return "number"
    elif is_datetime64_ns_dtype(x) or isinstance(x, (DatetimeTZDtype, PeriodDtype)):
        return "datetime"
    elif is_timedelta64_ns_dtype(x):
        return "duration"
    elif isinstance(x, ExtensionDtype):
        return "any"
    elif is_string_dtype(x):
        return "str"
    else:
        return "any"
